events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: Completed a verified test reservation: Atlas, Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 (1 hour), 12 people, Projector Included, reservation total $280 all charges included CAD, shown as Confirmed on both the confirmation page (evidence #13) and My reservations (evidence #15).

Interpretação simulada: Gather provided a short path from the preset meeting summary to a suitable room, an itemized pre-confirmation total, and a saved confirmation that could be re-checked in My reservations.

Limites: Reservation is for a demo venue and, per the site footer, is saved only in this browser session; no real payment or external calendar integration was tested. Only the Atlas path was needed, so other rooms were not fully compared.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirmed Atlas booking meets all requirements at $280
findings.observation: Review showed Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service charge $25 = Total $280; confirmation and My reservations both showed Confirmed Quarterly planning at Atlas, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, $280.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation matching purpose, capacity, projector, and all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona explicit requirements and charter success criteria; product review page promised 'All charges included · CAD' before confirming.
findings.personaComment: The total was clear before I confirmed, and the saved reservation matched exactly what I needed.
findings.interpretation: The flow made the budget decision checkable before commitment, which supports efficient completion for this persona.
findings.uncertainty: This was a demo reservation saved only in this browser session, with no payment taken; real-world availability and payment behavior were not tested.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Gather landing shows meeting Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required; Atlas $220/hr and Willow $235/hr both list 12 seats and Available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas is marked as the pick for my team, seats 12, and is the cheaper rate — I'll take a closer look at it.

feedback.summary: Meeting summary shows 12 people and projector required, letting me compare rooms without re-entering details
feedback.why: The bar at top confirms Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people and Projector required, and both Atlas $220 and Willow $235 show 12 seats and Available tomorrow.

experience.observation: Details page for Atlas shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included in your booking, and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: Good — the projector is shown as included for 12. Now I'll add the meeting name.

feedback.summary: Atlas summary confirms projector is included for 12 people, removing doubt before I continue
feedback.why: Right panel shows Atlas, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, and 'Projector Included in your booking', matching the core requirements.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder text.
experience.reaction: The name field is focused, so I'll type the meeting purpose now.

experience.observation: Meeting name field now reads Quarterly planning; Atlas summary still shows 12 people and projector included.
experience.reaction: Name is in as Quarterly planning — I'll go to review to check the total before confirming.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning for Atlas, 12 people, projector included, itemized total $280 all charges included.
experience.reaction: Total is $280 all-in, well under $350, with 12 seats and projector — I'll confirm it.

feedback.summary: Itemized total of $280 before confirming keeps the booking safely under the $350 limit
feedback.why: Review lists Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service charge $25 = $280 'All charges included · CAD', plus Quarterly planning, 12 people and projector included.

experience.observation: Confirmation page shows Confirmed Atlas for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector Included, total $280.
experience.reaction: That's the confirmed booking I needed — let me just verify it appears in my reservations.

feedback.summary: Confirmation card restates all requirements and the $280 total, letting me verify the booking at a glance
feedback.why: Screen shows Confirmed Atlas, Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included, and Reservation total $280 all charges included.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
